Galtee

recorded by Donal Maguire - after “The Old Bush” - which ties in with a previous discussion, and also by “Silly Wizard”.

The Dangerous Reel

Is what Mike Rafferty says his father called this tune. It appears on Mike and Mary Rafferty’s cd of the same name.

↳ Posted by Will Harmon on November 16th, 2005.

The Galtee, X:8

This setting from a recording of Mrs. Ellen Galvin (1887 - 1961) from Ballydineen, Knockalough, Co. Clare. She plays it after the Music in the Glen and before the Old Bush.

↳ Posted by Thady Quill on December 10th, 2023.
